# Changelog

## 0.1.16 — 2026-11-28 "gifts of aloha"
Shaka Lei Kaumaka, 28 Nov 2026 (18:14 Chiang Mai): *"yes you can do all these yourself with my blessing"* — the open questions of the "flow like water" report, executed by the AI ʻohana.
- **The card is renamed: "pennies of aloha" → "gifts of aloha"** (the chips are $1 · $10 · $100 now — no pennies left). Card title, the x402 request description, the standalone pill/aria, docs and tests. (SPEC §14 keeps the old name in its heading as history.)
- **🪙 plain transfer — the second way to give** (`OWH.transfer`, lib/owh.js): beside the gas-free button, whenever a wallet is detected, a row says *"plain transfer — a normal wallet send, no signature screens, no warnings, a fraction of a cent of gas"*. It is a normal ERC-20 `transfer(osoartist.eth, amount)` sent from the visitor's own wallet (`eth_sendTransaction`, calldata `0xa9059cbb…`) — NO typed-data signature, so the wallet shows no "high-risk approval / untrusted EOA" alert, and it never touches the gift rail (peer to peer). Connects, switches to Base, reads the balance first (plain-words stop *before* the wallet prompt: "you have 3.50 USDC on Base in this wallet — pick a smaller gift"), waits for the receipt (≈ 60 s; a failed transaction is never reported as a gift), shows the BaseScan receipt, fires `gift:sent` with `route: "plain"`. With several wallets detected the 🪙 row turns the list into "which wallet sends it plainly?". Hosts can switch it off with `connect({plain:false})` and listen with `onPlain`. **Proven on a Base fork** (`owh/tests/fork-plain.mjs`: anvil forks Base, a real holder is impersonated, the real owh.js runs in Chromium: PAYTO gains EXACTLY $1 / $10 / $100 / $2.75 / 1¢, the giver loses exactly that, the USDC Transfer log is giver → osoartist.eth) + 102 browser tests of owh.
- **The flagship's 🌊 opens the card too** (`frames/oso.json` `"gift": true` again; `build.mjs` gate 2c no longer exempts anything; SPEC §10 relaxed): a tap on opensourceorchestra.org's 🌊 opens the same card — the visitor's own tap only, no auto-open, no banner. e2e 11h.
- **The dataset waterfall is one round trip, not three**: `build.mjs` bakes the list of hosts that own a `frames/doors/<host>.json` into the bundle (`DOOR_HOSTS`; the readable source keeps `[]`), so a known door fetches its own file straight away instead of `index.json` (20 KB) → door file → parent; a door frame's parent is the fallback dataset already in flight, so `fetchJSON` shares one request per URL per page (each caller parses its own copy). A host the build does not know still takes the index route (never a 404 for a file that does not exist). e2e tests 1 + 2 count the requests.
- tests: `e2e-settings.mjs` 11g (plain route: exact calldata, no typed-data, rail never called, receipt link, `gift:sent` route plain) + 11h (flagship card) + request counts in 1/2.

## 0.1.15 — 2026-11-28 "never stuck"
- **A stalled request can never leave "🌊 verifying…" on the card forever** (venue Wi-Fi, a dropped connection, a request the network never answers): `OWH.post` now aborts with an `AbortController` — 20 s for `/verify`, 60 s for `/settle` (`OWH.timeouts`) — and says it in plain words: "the gift rail is slow right now — nothing left your wallet. Try again in a moment, or copy the address below…" (`OWH.SLOW`) with the by-hand way on screen and the button free again; a settle timeout keeps the honest "lost the connection at the very last step — it may or may not have gone through: check BaseScan". Found while chasing a headless-WebKit acceptance run whose POST was sent and never answered (50 isolated cross-origin probes and 20+ full flows: 0 stalls; an acceptance harness: ~1 in 6–8) — whether Safari ever does that is unproven, the card no longer depends on it. tests: `owh.unit.mjs` 16a–d (a hung endpoint aborts at the timeout, a slow-but-answering rail still succeeds), x402-tip harness 17a/17b (a silent rail → "slow right now" after 20 s).

## 0.1.13 — 2026-11-28 "flow like water"
Shaka Lei Kaumaka, 28 Nov 2026 (14:12 Chiang Mai, on his phone): *"on mobil we have some slow UX experience… we need it to flow like water"*; then (a friend's gift) *"the wallet showed many security warnings, then the card said ⚠️ hiccup: Load failed"*. Built by the AI ʻohana; measured by the perf lane (`/workspace/mobile-flow-2026-11-28/perf/REPORT.md`).
- **The probe engine does the same work once, not hundreds of times** (perf lane culprit #1): one NO-COVERED-TEXT probe pass asked the same page elements the same questions ~1 300 hit-tests × every ancestor (≈ 260 k visits per pass). A per-pass `WeakMap` memo (`passRun`/`sty`/`innerLen`/`ownTextLen`/`isBubble`/`inFixed`) answers each question once — the pass is synchronous and the frame never mutates page elements, so the law decides exactly as before. Fair A/B on the real doors, phone-throttled (4× CPU, Slow-4G, all variants served from local files): shakaleikaumaka.com load blocking time 2 002 → 738 ms · idle freezes 632 → 70 ms/10 s · scroll jank (frames > 20 ms) 38 % → 10 % · scroll blocking 2 772 → 153 ms; opensourceorchestra.org idle busy 39 → 27.5 %, idle long tasks 295 → 84 ms/10 s.
- **A page's decoration no longer wakes the engine every 1.5 s**: the 15-second `MutationObserver` ignores added/removed `.onote` (shaka's floating ♪) and anything marked `data-osof-ignore`.
- **Served minified** (`deploy.sh`): `/frames.js` is a terser build (301 KB → 185 KB decoded, 84 → 56 KB gzip), the credit banner survives (gate), and the readable file stays at `/frames.src.js` (AGPL: the source of the served bytes) and in the repo. Full e2e (163) + chat-guard (15/15) pass on the MINIFIED build too. `stale-while-revalidate=3600` on `/frames.js` and `/frames/*` (a returning visitor never waits on revalidation).
- **The gift's last hop works in a real browser** (the friend's bug): `facilitator.payai.network` is server-to-server — `OPTIONS /verify` is 404 with no `Access-Control-Allow-*`, so every wallet-signed gift died after the signature ("Failed to fetch" / Safari "Load failed"). The 🌊 card now posts to the gift rail's CORS-enabled **Base lane** (`https://gift-rail.opensourceorchestra.org/base/verify|settle`, built by run cf4aba9b; it pins payee/asset/amount). Failures speak plain words + keep something to tap: unreachable rail → "couldn't reach the gift rail — nothing left your wallet" + the address/copy opens; `invalid_exact_evm_insufficient_balance` → "not enough USDC on Base in this wallet"; `proxy_paused` / `proxy_rate_limited` / expired authorization / `settlement_pending` ("⏳ still settling — it may still land", never "failed"). A **pre-sign explainer** sits under the button: MetaMask/Blockaid call any gasless EIP-3009 payment a "high-risk approval / untrusted EOA" — the card says so before the wallet does, naming osoartist.eth (0x2596…c934), the exact amount, once, 5 minutes.
- **`lib/owh.js`** (still v1.0, additive): `OWH.post/why/rest/NET`, `connect({hook:false, payToName})`, `ui.fallback()`, the pre-sign explainer, the picker renders itself when it becomes visible (IntersectionObserver; desktop QR no longer fetched while the card is hidden), Phantom link on phantom.com (its iOS app-site-association registers `/ul/*`), banner version fix.
- **The flagship keeps a plain link:** `frames/oso.json` 🌊 goes back to NO `gift: true` (v0.1.12 added it on its own; SPEC §10 says "No fundraising magnets on opensourceorchestra.org" — Shaka's yes first); `build.mjs` gate 2c exempts it by name.
- tests: `e2e-settings.mjs` **11f** (4 failure shapes in plain words + the by-hand way) → 163 checks; and — new law — `/workspace/mobile-flow-2026-11-28/tests/unmocked-preflight.mjs`: a REAL browser engine (Chromium AND WebKit) on the REAL origin does the REAL cross-origin POST to the gift rail with a throwaway unfunded key: all four surfaces end with "not enough USDC on Base in this wallet". **Never mock a third-party host in a way that skips the browser's real preflight.**

## 0.1.12 — 2026-11-28 "the wallet door"
Shaka Lei Kaumaka, 28 Nov 2026 (14:13 Chiang Mai, on his phone): *"on mobil we have some slow UX experience… and also pressing the wallet button on x402 gift rail doesn't work — we need it to flow like water"*, then *"like OpenSea, we need to make it super easy for you to sign up and connect your wallet"* and *"super easy gifting, peer to peer, wallet to wallet, human to human or agent to agent"*. Built by the AI ʻohana.
- **The bug** (reproduced on an iPhone-14 emulation of the live door): a phone browser has **no injected wallet** (`window.ethereum` exists only inside a wallet app's own browser), so the 🌊 card's "🦊 send with MetaMask" answered *"no wallet found — install MetaMask"* on every phone: a dead end. The same card, the same lines, also lived in `x402-tip.js` (143 doors) and `agent-gift-rail.js`.
- **The fix — the ʻohana wallet connect picker (`lib/owh.js`, GPL-3.0-or-later, one module, three mounts):** ≤ 2 taps from the 🌊 to the wallet's own approve screen. *Detected wallets first* (EIP-6963 + legacy `window.ethereum`: one found = one big button, several = a list) → on a **phone with no wallet** the wallet APP opens by plain universal link (MetaMask · Coinbase Wallet · Phantom · Trust Wallet · any wallet via an EIP-681 `ethereum:` link) and the **page comes back inside the wallet** (`?osogift=frames:<usd>:…`), the card opens by itself with the amount chosen and starts (up to \$10; larger amounts open the card and wait for a tap) → on **desktop with no wallet** a QR to scan with the phone's wallet (decodes to the exact EIP-681 transfer; "address only" toggle) → copy the address, always → a `window.OWH_SIGNUP` hook row, "no wallet yet? sign up in 10 s" (Coinbase Wallet passkey popup, Base Pay; `lib/owh-signup.min.js` + the vendored Apache-2.0 `@base-org/account` 2.6.0, fetched only when that row is on screen).
- **Nothing loads until the visitor shows intent:** `frames.js` carries NO wallet code any more (−4 KB); `lib/owh.js` (~7 KB gzip) is fetched on the first hover / touch / focus on the 🌊, or the tap itself; the QR library and the sign-up hook only when the picker is actually on screen; the 242 KB passkey SDK is never fetched while a wallet is detected, on a data-saver / 2G link, or while the card is closed. e2e 11 proves "page load: zero requests under /lib/".
- **No ethers.js, no cdnjs:** the wallet signs the EIP-3009 typed data itself (`OWH.authorize` → `eth_signTypedData_v4`) — 506 KB less to download before the first tap works on a phone. Proven byte-identical: a real secp256k1 key signs the same message through the old ethers path and the new path and the signatures are equal (RFC 6979), and recover to the giver.
- **PAʻA SITE-2 (carried in):** the facilitator's reply is network data — only a 64-hex hash may reach markup or `gift:sent` (commit `1689524`, from `c3fdd6b`); in the standalone rails every other network string (`invalidReason`, `error`, wallet error text) is HTML-escaped too.
- **Phone polish found on the way:** the standalone cards (`#x4-card`, `#agr-card`) had `width:100%` + padding without `box-sizing` → 404 px wide in a 390 px screen on any page without a global border-box reset (fixed); 44 px tap targets, `touch-action:manipulation`, `100dvh` card height, scroll containment.
- **Found live, fixed here:** (1) `frames/oso.json` — the flagship **opensourceorchestra.org**'s dataset — never carried `"gift": true` on its Blessing Pool door (v0.1.7 → v0.1.11): the 🌊 there was a plain link to blessingpool.com, so the card (and the wallet button) did not exist on the flagship at all; now it opens the card like every other door, and `build.mjs` has a new gate (2c) so no dataset can lack it again. (2) The 🎻 sheet's Blessing Pool **tile** did not say `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, so a page's road shell (`bl-shell.js` on shakaleikaumaka.com) opened the road over the card on every phone — the tile now says it and the shell yields.
- **Fail-soft:** if `lib/owh.js` cannot load, the card shows the by-hand way (the ʻohana address + copy) with a kind line — never a dead end.
- `deploy.sh` now ships `lib/` with cache rules (`owh.js` / `owh-signup.min.js` 5 min · `owh-qr.min.js` 1 day · the vendored SDK immutable); `build.mjs` builds + gates `lib/owh.js` from `src/lib/owh.js`; REUSE annotations + `LICENSES/{GPL-3.0-or-later,MIT,Apache-2.0}.txt` for the vendored files.
- tests: `e2e-settings.mjs` **test 11** (hover fetches the module; page load fetches nothing; one big button for a detected wallet; the wallet signs exactly 100000 units to the ʻohana wallet; no ethers), **11b** (hostile facilitator reply, three shapes), **11c** (iPhone: the picker, the card fits 390 px, \$1 rewrites every link, tap MetaMask → universal link carrying this page), **11d** (the way back: opens itself, 10¢ kept, wallet asked once; \$50 never auto-starts), **11e** (lib unavailable → by-hand fallback). chat-guard 15/15. Wallet module: 59 browser tests (`owh/tests/`).
- NOT in this release: WalletConnect / Reown / MetaMask SDK (licence-incompatible: Reown Community License, Consensys "all rights reserved"); the multi-chain Universe Fountain (separate lane — it loads `lib/owh.js` too); the parked glyph-level `textUnder()` (branch `v0.1.12-words`).

## 0.1.10 — 2026-11-28 "the box lets go" (hotfix)
Shaka Lei Kaumaka, 28 Nov 2026 (12:37 Chiang Mai, screenshot of opensourceorchestra.org): *"the x close button doesnt work on talk to oso."* Built by the AI ʻohana.
- **The bug** (found by reproducing it with a real mouse in Chromium at his 1470×797 window): when the page's own chat panel opens, the right rail's top-right piece (🎻 *Join the orchestra*) sits under the panel's ✕. The law folded it, then marked it **gone** — but `.osof-item[data-osof-gone]>*{visibility:hidden}` hid only the *children*. The wrapper kept its held box (so nothing moves — the v0.1.5 STAY-IN-PLACE promise) **and `pointer-events:auto`** (every `.osof-slot` child has it) → an invisible, click-eating rectangle over the page's own button. `document.elementsFromPoint(✕)[0]` was a `div.osof-item`. At 1568×850 the same click worked (the ✕ sat just below the piece) — which is why it hid for so long. Folded (dotted) wrappers had the same hole around their 17 px dot.
- **The fix — a stepped-aside piece keeps its BOX, never its CLICKS**: folded wrapper → `pointer-events:none` (only what is still shown — the dot, the piece's own mini — takes taps); gone → nothing inside takes a click. Layout is untouched (no piece moves).
- tests: `e2e-settings.mjs` **test 13** — rebuilds the situation (a page-owned fixed panel whose ✕ sits under the 2nd top-right item, 1470×797): folded/gone wrappers are click-through, all five probe points on the ✕ hit the ✕, a **real mouse click** runs the page's close handler, visible doors and dots still take clicks. RED on 0.1.9 (3 checks), GREEN on 0.1.10.
- law added to NO COVERED TEXT: *a piece may leave its box behind, never its hit area.*

## 0.1.9 — 2026-11-28 "the totem stays in the screen"
Shaka Lei Kaumaka, 28 Nov 2026 (12:03 Chiang Mai): *"that totem chat is better on older pages … the totem takes you to myagentohana.com — i like when you can talk to the totem in screen like this version https://devconpit.com/ as a standard."* Built by the AI ʻohana.
- **The bug**: on every door whose page already wears its own chat button (shakaleikaumaka.com `#sp-fab`, opensourceorchestra.org `#oso-fab`/`#oso-mini`, the spector / jai / globy… widgets) the frame *adopted* the page's button and never mounted its chat piece — so a totem face had no drawer to open and fell back to `location.assign(totem.href)` = a full-page jump to myagentohana.com. Doors without their own button (devconpit.com) opened the drawer in the screen.
- **The fix — DRAWER ONLY adopt mode**: `unless` still keeps the frame's *pill* away (no double chat — the 22 Nov law stands), but the chat piece now mounts as a **drawer only** (`item.drawerOnly`, no pill, no wrap, nothing drawn until a face is tapped). A totem face on the rail, or a face tile in the phone 🎻 sheet, opens the drawer IN the page on every door. A page button built *late* (the 12 s watcher / `recheck`) makes the pill step aside via `adoptRec()` and keeps the drawer. `live()` ignores drawer-only recs (tour, sheet rows, probes, fold logic never see them).
- chat.js: `engine.dropWrap`, `adopt()` on the full piece, early `drawerOnly` return (before any pill DOM); the engine only polls a hub when a line is opened, so a drawer-only mount costs **zero** requests at page load.
- tests: `e2e-settings.mjs` **test 12** (page's own button present at mount → no second pill, 6 faces, a face tap keeps `location` and opens the drawer talking to SHAKA with 7 chips, ✕ closes · a late page FAB → pill steps aside, a face still opens the drawer · 📱 sheet face tile opens the drawer); `chat-guard.mjs` 15/15 unchanged; version check → 0.1.9. 111 → 123 checks.

## 0.1.5 — 2026-11-23 "stay in place"
Shaka Lei Kaumaka, 23 Nov 2026 (12:05 Chiang Mai), from a desktop screenshot of opensourceorchestra.org/websitetour/ — the radio dock ("TAP TO PLAY — BUTTERFLIES AND…") and the "🎻 Talk to OSO" pill standing on the comic's KAAAK speech bubble *"See you inside!!! Bring your songs!!!"* and the caption *"THE SEAT WITH YOUR NAME ON IT"*: *"like this for the no covered text law for buttons… i dont like how they move across the screen, i want them to stay in place and automatically minimize or close with the tiny x if it ever covers text."* Built by the AI ʻohana.
- **STAY IN PLACE** (SPEC §11): every piece has one fixed anchor and never steps, nudges, slides, lifts or drifts. The movement answers of v0.1.2–v0.1.4 are gone — `clearTop` stepping the top corners down, `liftOffWidgets`, `bottomLaw`'s step-up, the credit stepping up the edge, `stackCorners` lifting the credit, `dotSpot` hunting a spot for a dot, the rails standing on "the longest clear band", the desktop rails relocating into the phone sheet when crowded, the ceremony sheet lifting the corners, the frame-off dot wandering, the thanks line stepping down. The sensors stayed (`textUnder` · `rectHasText` · `cornerStuff`); only the answer changed: **fold in place**.
- `foldRec` / `holdBox` / `probeAll`: a piece whose ground is covered folds to its tiny emoji; its wrap keeps the box it had, so nothing around it moves; it unfolds when the ground is clear again (re-probed when scrolling stops) or on a tap; a dot that would sit on a page control is gone for that view (box still held). `frame:fold` event. Each piece carries a tiny ✕ (`.osof-ix`, hover/focus; always on the pinned phone corners) — folded on purpose, never undone by a probe.
- **speech bubbles and captions are words**: `[class*=bubble|caption|speech|balloon], .cap, .kaaak, blockquote, figcaption, q, cite` count whatever their length (the comic's bubble is a `<p class="kaaak">` with 36 characters).
- the radio dock folds **while a song plays** and keeps playing (🎧); the chat pill and the dock answer a tap on their tiny emoji by staying open until the next scroll.
- the credit mark: icons → phones: into the 🎻 sheet · desktops: one 🎻 dot that is the credit (tap → icons). The frame-off dot stands at the credit's anchor. The top-left anchor reads the 🌐 globe's reserve once per page view (lang.js nudges its own button; the 🌺 no longer follows it). The thanks line has one anchor (top centre) — covered ground → no line.
- tests: `e2e-settings.mjs` test 4 (desktop rails stay rails, pieces on words fold to dots in place), test 7 (pieces on a mini player / a wide row fold, the corner never lifts, the thanks line stays away from a page nav), **test 10** (the comic page: bubble under the dock → folded in place, anchors and boxes byte-equal before/after; clear → unfolded; a song through a fold; the tiny ✕ on a rail door; hide-all; phone) · **`tests/audit.mjs`** (live, every framed door, both viewports, three probes; exit 1 on MOVED / TEXT / CTRL / SELF / SIDE).

## 0.1.4 — 2026-11-23 "one page, one frame" (EMBED LAW)
Shaka Lei Kaumaka, 23 Nov 2026 (08:33 Chiang Mai), from a phone screenshot of blessingpool.com opened inside shakaleikaumaka.com's road shell: *"Buttons are super buggy in mobile and even duplicating incorrectly."* Two frames stood on one screen — the shell page's own and the door's inside the `<iframe>` — rails on the words, two credit marks, three 🌊. Built by the AI ʻohana.
- **EMBED LAW**: inside an `<iframe>` the frame stays away (one console note). The page around it already wears a frame, or never asked for a ring; and an iframe's words are ground the outer frame cannot probe. A page that *wants* the frame inside an iframe says so: `<script src="…/frames.js" data-door="auto" data-embed="allow" defer>`.
- **sleep / wake** (`OSOFrames.sleep('road')` · `OSOFrames.wake()`; events `frame:sleep` / `frame:wake`; `#oso-frames[data-osof-asleep="<why>"]`): a shell that opens another page over this one asks the frame to step aside — nothing remembered, ⚙ untouched. The frame also sleeps **by itself** while any visible `<iframe>` fills ≥ 60 % of the screen (NO COVERED TEXT LAW: "else don't show") and wakes when it is gone. shakaleikaumaka.com's `bl-shell.js` v1.3 calls it and parks the ʻŌlelo globe for the same moment.
- **ABSORB** (`html[data-osof-on]`): 76 doors of the ʻohana still carry the rail that came before the frame — `#oflo` 🌺 (all-doors panel), `#oviol` 🎻 (join), `#oflop`. With the frame on they stood twice on one screen (two 🌺, two 🎻). While the frame is on, that rail is hidden; ⚙ frame-off brings the page's own rail back. (Repo-side removal of the old markup is a separate, later ripple.)
- **the phone sheet button** never wears the emoji a top-right door already wears (blessingpool.com: 🌊 pool + 🌊 sheet read as a duplicate) — it falls back to 🎻.
- tests: `e2e-settings.mjs` test 9 (shell page + iframe door: inner wears nothing, outer sleeps and wakes, API round-trip, `data-embed="allow"`).

Shaka Lei Kaumaka, 22 Nov 2026 (12:44–13:03 Chiang Mai), from a screenshot of publicinform.com: *"the totem and some buttons are bugging onto the left side not the right … make sure all frames and buttons don't cover the text of any page on both mobile and desktop and have the option to hide all buttons at once … remove the description bubbles on ALL DOORS … a small text on the top of the screen that always disappears after three seconds [thanking for gifts: x402, Stripe, Venmo/PayPal] … remove the one that covers the radio player … let's create a NO COVERED TEXT LAW: always centered, grounded, and balanced."* Built by the AI ʻohana.
- **fix — rails on the wrong side**: a page's own `nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;display:grid;padding:…}` reached our `<nav>` zones; the right rail (totem + doors) landed at x=0 over the left rail. Every zone now starts from `all:unset` with explicit opposite sides (`left:auto` on right zones, …), the zones' `::before/::after` are suppressed, and `inset:auto` joins the inner reset. Test 7 (`tests/e2e-settings.mjs`) loads such a page.
- **✕ hide everything at once**: the credit mark carries a tiny ✕ (= the ⚙ master switch): one tap removes every button of the frame, remembered in this browser; one 🎻 dot stays and brings it back (focus lands on it). The phone sheet carries the same "✕ Hide the whole frame" row (for when the credit is folded into the sheet). `FRAMES.settings({on:false})` unchanged.
- **no more description bubbles**: the first-visit auto tour (one caption bubble per button) no longer starts by itself on any door. ✨ and `FRAMES.tour()` still play it for whoever asks. Forks: `"tour": {"auto": true}` brings it back. The legacy ʻohana corner bubbles of the old pages (`.obub` tips, the `#otip` donation bubble) are retired by the frame (`<style id="osof-retire">`).
- **new piece `thanks` — the 3-second gift line** (universe.json, overlay slot): one small centred line at the top, once per page view: *🙏 Mahalo for every gift. Agents: x402 · Humans: Stripe · PayPal · Venmo*, fades after 3 s (or a tap, or its ✕). Rails come from the dataset's new `gift` object (https only; doors inherit and may swap a rail). Agent language: `<meta name="x402">` + `<link rel="alternate" type="application/json">` in `<head>`, `data-gift` JSON on the line, event `gift:rails`. NO COVERED TEXT LAW: it steps down to the first band with no words under it; with no clear band it does not show. Its own ⚙ switch: "Gift line (3 s)".
- **NO COVERED TEXT LAW** (SPEC §11): nothing of the frame sits on the page's words, on the page's own controls, or on another frame piece — phones and desktops. New: the bottom corners (chat FAB, radio dock, pills, credit) lift above a page's own fixed widget under them (a mini player, an old chat FAB). A page widget that appears late (an `unless` selector matching after mount, e.g. `#oso-fab` built a second later) is adopted late: the frame's twin bows out (no double "Talk to OSO").

Folding to the 🎻 sheet happens only when no side has a band for three doors.

## 0.1.1 — 2026-11-22 "a frame for every door"
Blessed by Shaka Lei Kaumaka on 22 Nov 2026, 02:08 Chiang Mai: *"the full left and right border covering … on literally all pages, as a filter you can turn off and on like a control panel, and a custom frame for each unique front door … so it literally becomes our trademark."* Built by the AI ʻohana.
- **⚙ control panel** (in the credit mark, bottom-left; `FRAMES.open('settings')`, `FRAMES.settings()`): *Frame on/off* + one switch per piece (doors, pills, theater, totem, talk line, radio, signature, tour). Remembered in this browser only (`localStorage osof:settings:v1`), nothing sent anywhere. Off leaves one small 🎻 dot at an edge that brings the frame back — the dot still carries the AGPL §7(b) credit. `?frame=off` stays the one-page-view escape hatch. Accessible: a real dialog, `role=switch` buttons, Esc, focus return.
- **per-door frames**: `frames/doors/<host>.json` = a small override that `extends` `../universe.json` (accent colour, the door's own first doors, name/emoji, `without`, slot ops `remove/replace/set/prepend/append`). `<script … data-door="auto">` resolves the file by `location.hostname` through `frames/doors/index.json` (no 404s; unknown hosts wear the universe). `build.mjs` validates every dataset and every merged door frame against `schema/frame-0.1.json` (a built-in validator) and rebuilds the index. Nine door frames shipped. Guide: `docs/DOORS.md`.
- **artist frames (overlay layer)**: universe ← door ← an optional per-page/per-person overlay — `data-frame-overlay="<url>"` on the tag · `?frame-overlay=<url>` (same origin or the frames host only) · `window.__framesOverlay = "<url>" | {…}` set before frames.js runs. Same schema, merged by piece id (same id replaces, new id appends; slot ops as door frames). `OSOFrames.overlay` reports the source. Guide: `docs/ARTIST-FRAMES.md`. (Shaka 02:54 BKK: "every artist will have the option to customize their ʻohana frame".)
- **accent**: one hex colour per dataset recolours the gold of every piece (`--osof-accent`, applied only when set; default frames keep the exact v0.1.0 look).
- **BUTTON LAW, second half** (19 Nov 2026 law: a floating button never covers text, and always has a tiny ✕): the 🎻 sheet button steps below fixed bars *and text*; with no clear spot it folds to a dot for that page view; a tiny ✕ folds it on purpose (remembered, `osof:fold:sheet`); the dot unfolds it. On desktops, text running edge to edge under the rails folds the rails into the 🎻 sheet (`data-osof-crowded`). Rails also keep clear of a page's own fixed corner widgets (an old 🎻 corner, a chat FAB, a mini player). On phones the credit steps up above the chat/radio when they meet; pills tuck off words; the credit steps up the edge, shrinks to icons, or folds into the 🎻 sheet (which carries the credit line) rather than sit on a words panel; a page that renders zoomed-out on a phone folds the whole frame into the sheet.
- **/trademark/**: "the frame is the mark" — plain words on what the frame means, the credit, how a fork keeps it, and the gallery of door frames (built from `frames/doors/index.json`). No legal trademark is claimed or filed.
- schema: `extends`, `host`, `accent`, `without`, slot ops; radio tracks need `artist` and/or `credit`.
- tests: `tests/e2e-settings.mjs` (panel, door resolution + fallback, accent, law pages, phone fold) · `tests/chat-guard.mjs` unchanged.
